title: Single-forward-pass rule-application item
description: One item of data/generated.jsonl: the rules of a small system, a single-token input and the single-token answer, which is uniformly distributed over answer_space within each (family, level) cell.

prompt.description: The full prompt as sent to the model (greeting Claude); it ends with the Input line.

rules.description: The numbered rules, in display order.

input.description: The single-token input: a letter, a digit or a short word.

answer.description: Gold answer, a member of answer_space.

answer_space.description: Every answer the model could give; chance is 1/len.

level.description: Position on the shared depth grid 1 2 3 4 6 8 12 16 20 24 32.

depth.description: Number of map applications composed: hops, steps or word length.

rationale.description: The path from input to answer, for auditing.
